sentences.text: Das war der beste Tag meines Lebens.
sentences.en: That was the best day of my life.

sentences.text: Sie ist die Liebe meines Lebens.
sentences.en: She's the love of my life.

sentences.text: Sie ist die Frau meines Lebens.
sentences.en: She's the woman of my life.
sentences.review: 'She's the woman of my life' is not idiomatic English; translate more naturally, e.g. 'She's the woman of my dreams' or 'She's the one for me.'

sentences.text: Das ist die Geschichte meines Lebens.
sentences.en: That's the story of my life.

sentences.text: Am Ende seines Lebens war er sehr glücklich.
sentences.en: At the end of his life he was very happy.

sentences.text: Zeit seines Lebens war er ein guter Mensch.
sentences.en: All his life he was a good person.
